description: Web search: licensed Exa/Brave results with snippets — Runs a web search through a licensed search API (Exa or Brave) and returns up to 10 ranked results with title, URL, snippet, highlights and published date, for agents that need current links. Does not scrape search engines, does not fetch or summarize the result pages (use page-contents for that), and does not use a model.

date_from.description: Only results published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

include_text.description: Ask the provider for highlights/extra snippet text per result.

provider.description: auto uses Exa when configured, else Brave.

site.description: Restrict to a domain, for example example.com.

name: web-search
